description: Eight channels of clocked random gates: on each clock a coin toss per channel sets or clears that gate, with a trigger and a gated copy of the clock alongside it

params.text: Attenuverter for that channel's probability voltage, -1 to +1; at full travel 10V covers the whole probability range
Sets the chance of that channel's gate being set on each clock, 0 to 100%; in SINGLE it sets that channel's weight against the other seven
SINGLE picks one channel at random on each clock, making an eight-way Bernoulli gate; MULTI tosses for each of the eight channels separately

inputs.text: Each rising edge here makes a fresh toss; in MULTI a polyphonic cable clocks the eight channels separately, wrapping round when it carries fewer than eight channels
A rising edge here clears every gate, trigger and gated clock back to 0V
Voltage here moves that channel's probability up or down, by the amount and direction set on its PROB. CV attenuverter

outputs.text: 10V for as long as that channel's toss stays set, changing only when a clock produces a different outcome
A 1ms 10V trigger each time that channel's gate goes from low to high
Passes the incoming clock through at 10V while that channel's gate is high, and rests at 0V while it is low
All eight gates on one polyphonic cable, one to a channel
All eight triggers on one polyphonic cable, one to a channel
All eight gated clocks on one polyphonic cable, one to a channel

menu: Initialize Probabilities Only — puts the eight probability knobs back to their default positions
Randomize Probabilities Only — sets the eight probability knobs at random
Add CV expander — places a Clocked Random Gate CV Expander to the right of this module
Add logic expander — places a Clocked Random Gate Logic Expander to the right of this module

inputs.1: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
